experiment: V23k V23a official-CfC causal log1p decayed TR/RD observation-intensity inputs only
scope: V21 development KnownGate only; no OOF, test, Unknown, L3, full cascade, rejection, stable or P95

source_v23a.state_path: official CfC raw dt plus V23a positive-dt fixed retention; unchanged in V23k

observation_intensity.kappa_origin: 1 / V23a fixed_tau_seconds=15.025; fixed before development evaluation
observation_intensity.encoding: feature[t]=log1p([c_TR[t],c_RD[t]]) without fitted normalization or clipping
observation_intensity.causal_scope: current and earlier dt reasons plus current rd_quality.rd_present only; no labels, future events, parent-final aggregate, identifiers or model outputs
observation_intensity.first_and_zero_delta: raw dt=0, so the previous intensity is retained before the current increment
observation_intensity.positive_delta: uses the same raw positive second-precision duration supplied to the frozen V23a official-CfC path
observation_intensity.padding: does not update intensity state and emits zero feature values
observation_intensity.state_effect: input evidence only; does not alter official CfC timespan, official CfC hidden state equation, or V23a external positive-dt retention adapter
observation_intensity.rd_increment: number of current RD frames visible to the frozen model after its existing max-frame cap; rd_quality.rd_present is checked for exact availability consistency but existing frame-count/duration quality inputs remain unchanged

fixed_epoch20_diagnostic.comparison: fixed same epoch 20 V23k minus frozen V23a; descriptive only and never a checkpoint-selection override

parent_balanced_eligible_prefix.aggregation: eligible causal-prefix hard actions; each eligible parent has total weight one and each of its prefixes has weight 1/n_parent
eligible causal-prefix hard actions; each eligible parent has total weight one and each of its prefixes has weight 1/n_parent

paired_parent_bootstrap.method: paired parent bootstrap stratified by original base label

same_second_multiplicity.same_second_maximum_ordinal_2: at least one zero_delta and maximum causal same-second ordinal = 2
